title: Due Diligence Red Flags
rules: Customer Concentration: Any single client accounting for >15-20% of gross revenue is a deal-breaker or requires earnout protection.
Tax Return vs P&L discrepancy: If P&L shows $200k profit but tax return shows $20k, trust the tax return.
Deferred CapEx: Aging machinery requiring imminent replacement.
Lease cliff: Less than 5 years remaining on commercial lease with no fixed renewal option.
